data.standardized_narrative: Using the syndicate's gross claims development table, older underwriting years (2011-2015) show a net favourable movement resulting in an aggregate gross release of approximately GBP 71.4m. This release is driven by favourable development in several older years (notably 2012, 2014 and 2015) more than offsetting modest adverse movement in some other older years (eg 2011, 2013). The calculation is derived from the gross claims development triangle (page 43) and the opening gross claims outstanding balance (31-Dec-2016) used as the opening reserve.
data.data_quality_notes: Primary source for prior year movement: gross claims development table (claims triangle) on page 43. No explicit single-line narrative stating a gross prior-year movement was located; the prior year movement was calculated from the triangle per the instructions. Opening gross claims outstanding at 1-Jan-2017 was inferred from the gross claims provisions/technical provisions table (prior year comparative) on or around page 42. Gross premiums written and regulatory segmental premium breakout could not be reliably extracted from the scanned pages provided. Amounts in the triangle are presented in thousands in the report; values here are converted to millions. Confidence levels reflect: triangle calculation (0.8), inferred opening reserve (0.5) and missing explicit textual confirmation (exact_reserve_text left blank).
